metadata.title: SSPP Instance - Trusted Cloud (Microsoft 365)
metadata.remarks: Trusted Cloud SSPP instance for Microsoft 365 as a collaboration and productivity SaaS platform. Evaluates platform-level trust characteristics for data storage, processing, and governance.

import-profile.remarks: Inherits all normative platform trust, governance, and assessment expectations defined in the Trusted Cloud SSPP Template.

system-characteristics.system-description: Microsoft-operated SaaS platform providing email, document management, collaboration, and productivity services (e.g., Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams).

props.name: cloud-service-model
props.remarks: Microsoft 365 is consumed as a multi-tenant SaaS platform.

props.name: institutional-owner
props.remarks: Owns institutional use of Microsoft 365 for productivity and collaboration services.

props.name: business-owner
props.remarks: Accepts residual platform trust, residency, and jurisdictional risk for institutional data stored within Microsoft 365.

props.name: tenant-model
props.remarks: Customer data is logically isolated per tenant within Microsoft-operated infrastructure.

props.name: isolation-boundary
props.remarks: The Microsoft 365 tenant is the isolation boundary for customer content, configurations, and workloads.

props.name: personal-data-scope
props.remarks: Microsoft 365 stores user-generated content and associated metadata, including email, documents, files, collaboration artifacts, and personal information associated with those artifacts.

props.name: data-residency
props.remarks: Microsoft 365 tenant is geographically pinned to Canada, with Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Teams data hosted in Canadian data centres.

props.name: data-sovereignty
props.remarks: Microsoft is a U.S.-owned provider subject to U.S. jurisdiction. Customer data may be subject to lawful access under U.S. law regardless of hosting region.

props.name: provider-admin-access
props.remarks: Privileged access to customer environments by Microsoft personnel is controlled and audited under Microsoft internal controls.

props.name: independent-assurance
props.remarks: Microsoft maintains independent third-party security attestations (including SOC 2 and ISO certifications) applicable to Microsoft 365 services.

props.name: logging-availability
props.remarks: Microsoft 365 provides extensive audit logging, eDiscovery, retention, and compliance tooling subject to licensing and configuration.

props.name: subprocessor-transparency
props.remarks: Microsoft discloses subprocessors and provides customer notification of material changes in accordance with contractual terms.

props.name: data-exit-support
props.remarks: Customer content can be exported using supported Microsoft APIs and tools. Data deletion commitments are contractually defined.

components.title: Microsoft 365 SaaS Platform
components.description: Multi-tenant collaboration and productivity SaaS platform operated by Microsoft.
components.remarks: This SSPP instance evaluates Microsoft 365 at the platform trust level only. Identity control, authentication, and authorization are evaluated through Entra ID SSPPs.

control-implementation.remarks: Trusted Cloud controls for Microsoft 365 are satisfied through Microsoft disclosures, independent assurance, tenant isolation mechanisms, and built-in compliance and audit capabilities. Residency and sovereignty considerations are explicitly declared to support policy-driven assessments.
